title: Rapid, point-of-care, visual detection of RBD of SARS-CoV-2 spike protein using an acrylamide-free photonic crystal aptasensor

A straightforward method for the synthesis and fabrication of PS@poly(HEMA-AA) core-shell microsphere-based stimuli-responsive photonic crystals as an aptasensor platform for the specific detection of the RBD of the SARS-CoV-2 S protein.
